Recommendations

  1. src/app.ts Add integration tests for app entry point: verify middleware order, route mounting, and JSON error responses.
  2. src/services/userService.ts [SECURITY] Add timing attack test — measure response time for existing vs non-existent email over 10+ iterations; assert <100ms difference.
